title: Enable screen help on macOS
goal: Accessibility and Screen Recording are granted to Devagotchi Helper

steps.title: Two macOS permissions
steps.text: macOS needs Accessibility (to click and type) and Screen Recording (to see the screen) for Devagotchi Helper. You approve both in System Settings; nobody can grant them silently.

steps.title: Install the helper app
steps.text: Open the Devagotchi bridge package and move Devagotchi Helper.app to Applications, then start it once. It adds itself as a login item.

steps.title: Allow Accessibility
steps.text: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility and turn on Devagotchi Helper.

steps.title: Allow Screen Recording
steps.text: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording and turn on Devagotchi Helper.

steps.title: Relaunch the helper
steps.text: Screen Recording takes effect after the helper restarts. Quit Devagotchi Helper from its menu and open it again.

steps.title: Ready
steps.text: Screen help is ready. macOS may re-ask about Screen Recording from time to time; that is a useful reminder.
